is_this_iteration_five.answer: YES — it is iteration five of the same error class, and on one axis it is WORSE than iterations one to four.
what_genuinely_changed_and_is_not_nothin: The question moved. Designs 1-4 asked 'is this position a claim?' and answered with a syntactic property of the receipt. artifact_binding genuinely does not ask that: the exemption list is empty (grep rc=1, verified), the verdict's exemptions block is four empty arrays, and design 4's tolerance defect provably cannot re-enter (f1/f5/f7 all rc=1; 7 hostile env vars change nothing). That is a real structural gain.

The judgement moved from 'which positions are excused' to 'what did the verifier cause to run'. That IS a different kind of question, and output_dependence's denominator (x8 rc=3) is the first total denominator in five iterations.
is_this_iteration_five.why_it_is_still_the_same_error: The judgement still rests on a syntactic property; the property was relocated from the RECEIPT to the EXECUTION. All three modules pick a variant of one property — RESPONSIVENESS TO A PERTURBATION THE VERIFIER KNOWS AND THE PRODUCER CAN PREDICT — and stand it in for the judgement 'this number is the declared measurement'. It fails the same two ways a name, a path, a type and a bound failed: it is satisfiable without computing (c1, c2, j1, y1, y10, x3 — all measured at exit 0), and it is not satisfied by honest values that legitimately do not respond (h1_honest_jax rc=3, x6 rc=1, y0 rc=4 — all measured by me).
is_this_iteration_five.the_axis_on_which_it_is_worse: Iterations 1-4 were wrong in ONE direction: a name-based surface let fabrication through but never rejected honest work. Iteration five is wrong in BOTH directions at once, because mathematical invariance is a real property of real observables. A spectral signature, a rank, a count, a dimension and a trace that does not depend on an off-diagonal coupling are all genuinely computed and genuinely unresponsive. output_dependence REFUSES two of them at exit 1 (x6: jnp.sum(ev > 0) and jnp.linalg.matrix_rank — I read the leg and measured the refusal). This is precisely the root cause the engine_witness Purgatory record already named — 'it also rejects genuine work, so it is wrong in both directions at once' — reproduced by all three of its replacements.

Its census measured concrete slipping documents for 22 of 22 declared exempt paths, which is a large part of why the exemption-list design was abandoned at all. THE ONE GENUINELY WASTED SCOUT RESULT. Draft 2020-12 unevaluatedProperties:false converts an open negative enumeration (things that are exempt, whose completeness is unknowable) into a CLOSED positive one (every position that may exist, enumerable from the schema document). That is the direct answer to surface 2 — the measured d1 gap where 8 real measurements sit outside the walker's shape at exit 0. It was scouted with five measured fixture refusals, it is installed, and it was then neither adopted nor excluded with a reason. Unlike the jaxpr case there is no recorded measurement saying why not.
per_library.caveat_that_still_applies: The scout's own measurement stands: jsonschema validates the PARSED object, so {"metrics":{"gap":1.78},"metrics":{}} validates clean after last-wins parsing. strict_parse must stay upstream of any validator. Adopting jsonschema does not retire strict_parse — and julia_witness's json.loads at line 885 is the live proof that this lesson has not landed.

MERGE THE TWO CHECKS THE PACKAGE ALREADY HAS. output_dependence has a total denominator and no receipt-value comparison; julia_witness has the comparison and a one-path denominator. Each module's open defect is closed in the other, in the same package, in the same commit. Merging refuses x1, y6 and y9. It does NOT close x2, x3, y1, y10, a4, o1 or c1, because fake movement, laundered tracking and producer-chosen functions touch neither check.
what_would_actually_change_the_kind_of_t: THE VERIFIER MUST COMPUTE THE DECLARED FUNCTION, not run the producer's program and probe it. Every unearned pass I measured that survives all one-line repairs — a4, o1, c1, y1, y10, x3 — survives because the producer chose what function runs. A recompute is only evidence when the recomputed function is fixed outside producer write-control.

THAT REQUIRES A TRUST ROOT THAT DOES NOT EXIST. git ls-files | grep -i codeowner returns nothing tracked, and claim_policy.json's _ownership field says so about itself. Until a layout or schema document is unwritable by the producing agent, every green result in this package measures what the verifier ran, not who was allowed to define the rule. This is the same structural caveat as the recorded BY_CONSTRUCTION finding where a 12/12 green measured one status token. The trust root is the prerequisite, not a later hardening step.

THE DENOMINATOR MUST BE DEFINED OVER THE RECEIPT BYTES, or by a CLOSED POSITIVE ENUMERATION of every position that may exist. Numbers in keys, in prose and in JSON-encoded strings must either enter the denominator or be measured and committed as a count that FAILS WHEN IT GROWS. jsonschema's unevaluatedProperties:false is the installed, measured mechanism for the closed-world form; strict_parse stays upstream of it.

A CONTROL THAT REFUSES A MATHEMATICALLY INVARIANT OBSERVABLE IS NOT READY, whatever its fail-open count. A rank, a signature, a count, a dimension and a trace independent of the perturbed parameter are all genuine engine outputs. Any design whose crediting test is responsiveness must first state which observables it structurally cannot witness, and must PARK rather than REFUSE them.

THE PERTURBATION FAMILY MUST NOT BE THE LOAD-BEARING TEST, and making it unguessable does not rescue it. Measured: l1 detects the probe through the input itself, and x3 reconstructs the affine map from the engine's own returns. A severance is detectable by its own effect, so 'the leg cannot tell it is being probed' is unobtainable by construction.

IF A BURN-DOWN IS USED, IT MUST BE A COUNT, NEVER A LIST. 44 receipts and 35686 leaves cannot be converted at once. The debt must be a per-(pointer, receipt_sha256) count that may only decrease, never a grandfathering list keyed on path or name — a grandfathering list is iteration one wearing a schedule.
